plot: The morning after dinner Grandma has planted petunias in Mr. Pot on the garden table, and a bee on his flowers makes the stuck, dirt-filled villain shake toward the edge, where a crack would mean the trash; Bup gloats, but Crispy says nobody deserves the trash, Zeek's Plan Breeze only lands the bee on Pot's nose, Grandma comes out with her watering can, and — the twist — Pim, who is scared of everything, is calm with bees because he grew up on a bean plant (he said it early on): he walks the bee to the lavender while Grandma waters Pot; grateful Mr. Pot tells them the baker who lived here left an old bread box in the pantry, and it isn't empty.

script.title: Mr. Pot Has Flowers Growing Out of Him

beats.say: Get. This. Bee. Off. My. Flowers!
Mr. Pot has... flowers on his head?!
Morning in the garden. Grandma planted petunias in Mr. Pot.
He's full of dirt. He can't move. And a bee found him.
New episode every day. Subscribe so you don't miss what happens next.
Team, this is the best morning of my life.
Bup! Don't be mean. Not even to him.
Laugh now, crumbs. When I'm free, you're all toast.
The bee buzzes past his three eyes. He freezes.
Is it on me? Don't tell me. Tell me!
Fascinating. The great Mr. Pot is scared of a bee.
Bees are nice. Back home, bees visited my bean flowers.
Pim, you're scared of spoons. Please focus.
He shakes so hard he slides toward the garden table's edge.
If he falls, he cracks. Cracked pots go in the trash.
Nobody deserves the trash. I know how that feels.
Plan Breeze. We blow the bee away. One, two, three!
Five tiny breads blow. Pfff.
The bee lands right on Mr. Pot's nose.
IT'S ON MY NOSE! I CAN SEE IT WITH ALL THREE EYES!
He rocks. Left. Right. Half of him hangs over the edge.
Grab his handles! Everybody pull him back!
They pull. He tips back. Barely. Dirt rains on Zeek.
I have soil in my glasses. This is a new low.
The back door opens. Grandma comes out with her watering can.
Grandma's coming! And he still can't stop shaking!
If he falls in front of her, he's trash by lunch.
I'm not shaking. I'm... vibrating. With anger. Mostly.
Everyone thinks hard. Everyone except Pim.
Pim walks up to the bee. Slowly. He isn't shaking.
Bees aren't mean. They're just very busy. Like Zeek.
Pim holds out one hand. The bee walks right onto it.
Pim. You're scared of your own shadow!
I grew up on a bean plant. Bees are family.
The bee won't leave his hand. Grandma is three steps away.
Pim, she'll see you! Move that bee, and move yourself!
Bees love purple. The lavender by the fence! Take it there!
Pim walks the bee across the lawn. One careful step.
A slipper lands next to him. Pim freezes. Just a bean.
Grandma waters the petunias. Mr. Pot gargles quietly.
Glug. I. Hate. This. Glug.
At the lavender, the bee hums and flies into the purple.
Mr. Pot stops shaking. For once, he's still.
You... helped me. Why would a bean help me?
Because you were scared. I know what scared looks like.
And because Grandma likes you. Lucky old pot.
Grandma pats Mr. Pot. 'Prettiest pot in the whole garden.'
Don't. Tell. Anyone.
Too late. Pim the bee whisperer. I'm telling everyone.
Mr. Pot grumbles. Then he lowers his voice.
Fine. I owe you one. Listen. A baker lived here before you.
His old bread box is still in the pantry. It's not empty.
What do you think happens in the next part?
Tell me in the comments.

long.title: Mr. Pot Has Flowers Growing Out of Him 🌸 (Ep 19)
long.description:
What do you think happens in the next part? Tell me in the comments.
"Everyone thinks I'm scared of everything. Not bees. Bees are family." — Pim
Grandma turned Mr. Pot into a flowerpot, a bee won't leave him alone, and if he shakes off the garden table he cracks — so the Dough Bros have to decide whether to save their old enemy.
#series #3DAnimation #DoughBros

es.title: A Mr. Pot le salen flores de la cabeza 🌸 (Ep 19)
es.description:
¿Qué crees que pasa en la siguiente parte? Cuéntamelo en los comentarios.
"Todos creen que me asusta todo. Las abejas no. Las abejas son familia." — Pim
La abuela convirtió a Mr. Pot en una maceta, una abeja no lo deja en paz y si se cae de la mesa del jardín se rompe: los Dough Bros deben decidir si salvan a su viejo enemigo.
#serie #Animación3D #DoughBros

pt.title: Estão nascendo flores no Mr. Pot 🌸 (Ep 19)
pt.description:
O que você acha que acontece na próxima parte? Conta nos comentários.
"Todo mundo acha que eu tenho medo de tudo. De abelha, não. Abelha é família." — Pim
A vovó transformou o Mr. Pot em vaso de flores, uma abelha não larga ele e, se ele cair da mesa do jardim, racha — os Dough Bros precisam decidir se salvam o velho inimigo.
#série #Animação3D #DoughBros

ar.title: الزهور تنمو من رأس السيد بوت 🌸 (Ep 19)
ar.description:
ماذا تظن أنه سيحدث في الجزء القادم؟ أخبرني في التعليقات.
"الجميع يظن أنني أخاف من كل شيء. إلا النحل. النحل عائلتي." — بيم
حوّلت الجدة السيد بوت إلى أصيص زهور، ونحلة لا تتركه، وإن سقط عن طاولة الحديقة سيتشقق — فعلى الأصدقاء أن يقرروا: هل ينقذون عدوهم القديم؟
#مسلسل #رسوم_ثلاثية_الأبعاد #DoughBros

fr.title: Des fleurs poussent sur Mr. Pot 🌸 (Ep 19)
fr.description:
À ton avis, que se passe-t-il dans la prochaine partie ? Dis-le-moi en commentaire.
"Tout le monde croit que j'ai peur de tout. Pas des abeilles. Les abeilles, c'est la famille." — Pim
Mamie a transformé Mr. Pot en pot de fleurs, une abeille ne le lâche plus, et s'il tombe de la table du jardin, il se fend : les Dough Bros doivent décider s'ils sauvent leur vieil ennemi.
#série #Animation3D #DoughBros

ja.title: ミスター・ポットから花が生えてきた 🌸 (Ep 19)
ja.description:
次のパートで何が起きると思う？コメントで教えてね。
「みんな僕が何でも怖がると思ってる。でもハチは平気。ハチは家族なんだ。」— ピム
おばあちゃんがミスター・ポットを植木鉢にしてしまった。ハチは離れず、庭のテーブルから落ちれば割れてしまう。ドウ・ブロスは昔の敵を助けるのか？
#シリーズ #3Dアニメ #DoughBros

ko.title: 미스터 팟에게서 꽃이 자라고 있다 🌸 (Ep 19)
ko.description:
다음 편에서는 무슨 일이 일어날까요? 댓글로 알려 주세요.
"다들 내가 뭐든 무서워한다고 생각해. 벌은 아니야. 벌은 가족이거든." — 핌
할머니가 미스터 팟을 화분으로 만들었고, 벌 한 마리가 떠나지 않는다. 정원 테이블에서 떨어지면 깨지고 만다 — 도우 브로스는 옛 적을 구할까?
#시리즈 #3D애니메이션 #DoughBros

de.title: Aus Mr. Pot wachsen Blumen 🌸 (Ep 19)
de.description:
Was glaubst du, passiert im nächsten Teil? Schreib es in die Kommentare.
"Alle denken, ich habe vor allem Angst. Nicht vor Bienen. Bienen sind Familie." — Pim
Oma hat Mr. Pot zum Blumentopf gemacht, eine Biene lässt ihn nicht in Ruhe, und fällt er vom Gartentisch, bekommt er einen Sprung – die Dough Bros müssen entscheiden, ob sie ihren alten Feind retten.
#Serie #3DAnimation #DoughBros
